text:
Jordan (People Ops): Heads-up: All-hands Monday 9:00am PT. Please add short agenda bullets or questions by Sunday EOD. Meeting will be recorded.

Leah (CEO): I'll open with a quick company health update and two strategic priorities for the quarter.

Marco (Product): I'll show the new rollout plan for Dedicated autopilot and a 5-min demo. tagging @Tess for any runtime notes.

Tess (Eng): I'll be on the call. quick note: we need to mention the new default debug-log retention policy and what Dedicated customers can opt into.

Jordan (People Ops): added to agenda. draft: 9:00 intro + priorities (Leah), 9:10 Product demo (Marco), 9:20 Eng callouts (Tess), 9:30 CS highlight (Rae), 9:35 Q&A, 9:50 Close + TL;DR.

Rae (Customer Success): I'll surface the customer pilot feedback and metrics (NPS up, one regression we want to flag).

notify-bot: Calendar invite posted -> https://calendar.example.com/event/3111122334. Zoom link included.

Omar (Platform): I'll drop a short slide showing p95 latency improvements from KV cache and a note on quantization tests.

Marco (Product): request: can someone from infra join the Q&A for rollout troubleshooting? @Tess @Omar

Tess (Eng): yes, available. also here's the CLI snippet we might paste in answers if people ask about batching defaults:
```
redwoodctl config set batching.max_batch 48
redwoodctl deploy inference --env=prod
```

Jordan (People Ops): Reminder: keep bullets to 2 lines max so we can keep to time. if you can't make it, we'll post recording and short transcript.

Leah (CEO): For folks who miss it 2 bullets: 1) Autopilot canary next week; 2) debug-log retention default shortened to 30 days (Dedicated can extend); 3) Console dark-mode pilot is live as opt-in; 4) p95 improved ~15%. Slides+recording after.

Rae (Customer Success): can we also note the support path for Dedicated customers who want retention changes? I'll add a one-liner for slides.

Tess (Eng): added RFC link in thread: https://docs.redwood.example.org/rfcs/log-retention-2026 (contains migration steps).

Jordan (People Ops): Last call for agenda items/questions. Use replies here or the form: https://forms.gle/example-allhands.

(After meeting) notify-bot: Recording available: https://videos.example.com/recordings/3111122334, Slides: https://drive.example.com/3111122334-slides.pdf

Jordan (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR posted below: 
- Autopilot: canary next week, phased rollout over 5 weeks, owners assigned in follow-up doc.
- Policy: debug-log retention default to 30 days; Dedicated customers can request extensions via support.
- Console: dark-mode opt-in enabled; design will collect feedback.
- Platform: p95 latency down ~15% after KV cache changes; further gains expected from quantization experiments.

Leah (CEO): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the cross-team work on the rollout and perf wins.

Marco (Product): I'll create the rollout checklist and owners doc and link it here.

Tess (Eng): Follow-up: created a short troubleshooting playbook for the rollout -> https://docs.redwood.example.org/playbooks/autopilot-rollout-playbook

Rae (Customer Success): Filed a support KB for Dedicated retention requests and linked it in slides.

Jordan (People Ops): Actions captured. If anyone had a question that didn't get answered, DM me and I'll route it. Meeting closed. :sparkles:
